subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

facts.label: Name
facts.value: 正大光明殿 Zhengda Guangming Dian

facts.label: Changed
facts.value: Plain under Yongzheng; columns painted red and capitals with dragons before the end of Qianlong (S02 p.76)

facts.label: Bays
facts.value: 7 in the texts / 7x1 on the plan

facts.label: 日下旧闻考
facts.value: 出入賢良門内為正大光明殿七楹 [j80:9b]

facts.label: Note
facts.value: S06 进深五间. Malone p.75 measured the foundation on site: 129 x 63 ft, 4 ft high = 39.3 x 19.2 x 1.2 m; porch colonnade of 10 columns; pillars c. 2 ft 8 in. Macartney 150 x 60 ft (S02 p.76). Interior height over 20 ft per Staunton (S02 p.76 n.). Macartney gifts 1793 set up here. Scene of camp and last fire 1860 (S02 p.77). 不雕不繪 per 1744 poem [j80:11a].
